title: Refusing what is freely offered
odia: ମାଗି ଖାଉଥାଏ ବାସି ତୋଡ଼ାଣି, ଯାଚିଲେ ନ ଖାଏ ସର ଲବଣୀ
literal_meaning: They ask for stale rice-water to eat, yet refuse cream and butter when offered.
explanation: The contrast mocks a refusal that appears at odds with what someone usually seeks. An unsolicited offer is rejected despite being presented as more desirable.
meaning_odia: ମାଗି ସାଧାରଣ ଜିନିଷ ନେଉଥିବା ଲୋକ ଯାଚିଦେଲେ ଭଲ ଜିନିଷକୁ ମଧ୍ୟ ନେବାକୁ ମନା କରିବା—ଏହି ବିରୋଧାଭାସକୁ କଥାଟି ଚିଡ଼ାଏ।
usage_example: Someone repeatedly asks to borrow basic tools but declines a better set freely offered by a neighbour. (New editorial example, not a collected quotation.)
cultural_context: The dictionary explicitly labels this a dhaga under offering something. Rice-water interprets the witness spelling ତୋଡ଼ାଣି without changing it. The saying does not explain why the offer is refused; consent and personal preference remain valid.
